# Cache

For caching, Ibexa DXP offers both HTTP cache for content views, and persistence cache.

Ibexa DXP offers both HTTP cache for content views, and persistence cache.

- [HTTP cache](../http_cache/http_cache/index.md): Ibexa DXP's HTTP cache functionalities enable using reverse proxies - Symfony HttpCache Proxy, Varnish or Fastly.
- [Reverse proxy](../http_cache/reverse_proxy/index.md): You can use Symfony HttpCache Proxy, Varnish or Fastly as reverse proxies with Ibexa DXP.
- [Persistence cache](../persistence_cache/index.md): Persistence cache caches SPI\\Persistence calls used in common page loads.
